Documentation.short_help: SHYX Selection Append Patches: Add overlapping extracted patches into a PartitionedDataSetCollection.
Documentation.long_help: Snapshots cell selections into the patch table (default names Part_0, Part_1, ...). Rename and set a constant Mark per row. Apply runs vtkExtractSelection per row and appends each extract as its own vtkPartitionedDataSet. Patches may overlap; unselected parent cells are not appended; no GlobalIds. Mark is written as a constant cell/field array (Mark Array Name, default PatchMark) on every cell of that patch.

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: Parent mesh. Cell ids in the patch table refer to this dataset.

InputProperty.name: Selection
InputProperty.label: Selection
InputProperty.Documentation: Optional live vtkSelection. Hidden from the default panel: Add from selection reads the 3D-view selection directly (Copy Active Selection is not required). Used when the patch table is empty (single Part_0) or as an Add fallback / Python SelectionInput.

StringVectorProperty.name: MarkArrayName
StringVectorProperty.label: Mark Array Name
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Name of the constant cell/field array written on each extracted patch.

StringVectorProperty.name: PatchNames
StringVectorProperty.label: Patch Names
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Newline-separated patch names (table Name column). Shown via the Patches table, not as a raw text box.

StringVectorProperty.name: PatchMarks
StringVectorProperty.label: Patch Marks
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Newline-separated mark values aligned with Patch Names.

StringVectorProperty.name: PatchCellIds
StringVectorProperty.label: Patch Cell Ids
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Newline-separated cell-id lists aligned with Patch Names. Comma-separated ids or ranges (0-10,15) on the Input dataset.
